title: Orders on Information Hold at a Missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit
content:
## Billing compliance note — Specimen Collection Appointments

The no-show charge of a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit is multiplied by a held-order share that depends on whether the order the visit was to collect is on an information hold, why, and since when. The note reads the order's record in Laboratory Test Orders — whether its status is on information hold, the hold reason and the date the hold was placed — and, for a missing diagnosis, whether the patient has a live coverage on file in Insurance Coverage & Claims. A coverage counts as live until it is terminated.

**Clause.** When the order the visit was to collect is on an information hold for a missing diagnosis that was placed on or before the appointment date and the patient has a live coverage on file (a coverage counts as live until it is terminated) to which the diagnosis codes must go, the collection could not have gone ahead for a reason on the ordering provider's side and the charge is multiplied by 0.50; when the order is on an information hold that was placed on or before the appointment date for a reason the patient had to resolve (an Advance Beneficiary Notice or an informed consent still to be signed, or a missing diagnosis while the patient has no live coverage on file, so that the patient had to put a coverage on file or switch the order to self-pay), the charge is multiplied by 0.75; otherwise the charge stands in full.

## Table

| Order on information hold, placed on or before the appointment date, for | Live coverage on file | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| A missing diagnosis | Yes | 0.50 |
| A missing diagnosis | No | 0.75 |
| An Advance Beneficiary Notice still to be signed | Any | 0.75 |
| An informed consent still to be signed | Any | 0.75 |
| Any other hold reason (coverage unverified, prior authorization pending) | Any | Stands in full |
| — order not on information hold, or its hold placed after the appointment date | Any | Stands in full |

## Cases (hypothetical, missed appointment on day A)

- Hold for a missing diagnosis placed on day A minus 5; the patient has an active coverage: 0.50.
- Hold for a missing diagnosis placed on day A itself; the patient's only coverage is terminated: 0.75 — the hold was placed on the appointment date, which counts as "on or before".
- Hold for an informed consent still to be signed, placed on day A plus 2: stands in full — placed after the appointment date.
- Order received and not on hold: stands in full.
